subject: enhance raxLowWalk: use memchr() for child-edge lookup in non-compressed nodes (#3472)
reason: The change replaces the open-coded first-match byte scan in raxLowWalk's non-compressed branch with memchr(), which returns the same first-occurrence index and the same not-found condition; the only divergent state, the local j after a not-found break, is never observable because *splitpos is only written when the stop node is compressed and the break occurs only in the non-compressed branch.
